# llm-session-replay

> Record LLM client calls to a JSONL session file and replay them strictly in order for deterministic Go tests, with request hashes, field-level mismatch errors and integrity checks. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u209-llm-session-replay`, package `llmsessionreplay`, Go >= 1.22, standard library only.
